ip_top_stories.title: Suno Signs BMG Licensing Deal 12 Days After German Court Ruled Against Its AI Training
ip_top_stories.summary: AI music generator Suno has signed a licensing deal with BMG, coming just 12 days after a German court ruled against its AI training practices. The deal marks a significant development in the music industry's push to secure licensing agreements with AI companies following litigation.

ip_top_stories.title: The American Dollar & Jamendo Abruptly Drop Suno Lawsuits
ip_top_stories.summary: Musicians The American Dollar and Jamendo have abruptly dropped their copyright lawsuits against AI music company Suno. The dismissals come amid broader legal and licensing developments surrounding Suno's AI training practices.

ip_top_stories.title: Evidence of unfair use: AI books squeeze human authors out of the market
ip_top_stories.summary: A new analysis presents evidence that AI-generated books are displacing human authors in publishing markets, raising questions about unfair competition and copyright. The piece examines the commercial impact on authors as AI content floods book platforms.

ip_top_stories.title: AI Bots Are Stripping European Booksellers' Shelves; EU Copyright Law May Ban It
ip_top_stories.summary: AI bots are scraping European booksellers' websites at scale, raising alarm among publishers and booksellers. EU copyright law may offer a basis to ban the practice, with discussion of how existing legal frameworks apply to automated data harvesting.

ip_top_stories.title: The Copyright Battle That Could Push AI Out of Reach
ip_top_stories.summary: This analysis examines the ongoing copyright litigation and policy battles over AI training data, arguing that aggressive rights enforcement could significantly restrict AI development and access. The piece considers the broader economic and legal consequences of how courts and legislators resolve these disputes.

ip_further_links.title: California AI Bills Face Final Vote Today: Chatbot Safety, Copyright, US-First Commission
ip_further_links.summary: California's legislature was set to vote on a package of AI bills including measures touching on copyright and chatbot safety, with some transparency provisions advancing while enforcement mechanisms failed.

ip_further_links.title: Thailand warns AI music creators over potential copyright infringement
ip_further_links.summary: Thailand's Department of Intellectual Property has warned AI music creators of licensing risks and potential copyright infringement under existing law.

ip_further_links.title: AI in Film Legal Questions: You Made It With AI. Do You Own it?
ip_further_links.summary: An examination of the unresolved legal questions surrounding copyright ownership of AI-generated film and creative content.

ip_further_links.title: Copyright across the genAI lifecycle – views from computer science and law
ip_further_links.summary: An interdisciplinary analysis of how copyright law applies at different stages of the generative AI lifecycle, drawing on perspectives from both computer science and legal scholarship.

ip_further_links.title: Can AI use your creative work freely in Malaysia?
ip_further_links.summary: An overview of how Malaysian copyright law applies to AI training on creative works, and whether rights holders have legal recourse.

ip_further_links.title: Anthropic paid $1.5 billion over books! Here is where AI copyright law actually stands now
ip_further_links.summary: An overview of the current state of AI copyright law, using Anthropic's reported $1.5 billion book licensing settlement as a lens to examine where litigation and policy currently stand.

ip_further_links.title: Roundtable #36: Scraping By: Generative AI and the Limits of Cross-Border Governance
ip_further_links.summary: A roundtable discussion examining the challenges of regulating AI web scraping across different national legal frameworks and copyright regimes.

ip_further_links.title: McGraw Hill Touts AI in Improving First Quarter Results [Metered]
ip_further_links.summary: McGraw Hill has highlighted the role of AI tools in improving its financial results for the first quarter, signalling growing integration of AI in academic publishing operations.

ip_further_links.title: Secondhand book sales are booming. Is it because of AI?
ip_further_links.summary: An analysis of whether growing consumer concern about AI-generated content is driving increased demand for secondhand physical books.

ip_further_links.title: Artificial Intelligence and Intellectual Property Rights in India: Authorship, Ownership, Inventorship and the Emerging Legal Challenges
ip_further_links.summary: An academic overview of how Indian IP law addresses questions of authorship, ownership, and inventorship raised by AI-generated works.
